name: Capgemini

roles.name: Analyst
roles.note: Base fresher track. FACE Prep reports ~₹4.0–4.5 LPA; verify in your offer.

roles.name: Senior Analyst
roles.note: Same test; per FACE Prep, a higher aptitude cutoff plus an advanced technical interview, at ~₹6.5–7.5 LPA (secondary figure).

rounds.name: Pseudocode / Technical MCQs
rounds.what_they_check: Reading and tracing code logic: loops, recursion, arrays, bit operations and basic CS concepts. Sources disagree on size (e.g. 30 questions in 30 minutes vs 25 in 25 vs 40 in 40), so counts are unknown.
prep: Trace output of C-style pseudocode with nested loops and recursion by hand.
Revise bitwise operators, operator precedence and integer division behaviour.
Revise basic OOP, DBMS and OS MCQ facts that appear alongside pseudocode.

rounds.name: English Communication Test
rounds.what_they_check: Written English via MCQs on grammar, reading comprehension and vocabulary. Most sources say ~30 questions in ~30 minutes; FACE Prep gives a shorter figure.
prep: Do one timed reading-comprehension passage daily.

rounds.name: Quantitative & Game-based Aptitude
rounds.what_they_check: Numerical ability plus cognitive skills (memory, pattern recognition, deductive reasoning) through short games. Most sources say four games (~20–30 minutes); one candidate source describes more.
prep: Try sample game-based assessments (grid memory, switch/pattern games, deductive logic) to learn the mechanics.
Practise core quant: percentages, ratios, averages, simple data interpretation.
Stay calm: game difficulty often adapts as you answer correctly.

rounds.name: Behavioural Competency Test
rounds.what_they_check: Work-style and personality via paired statements (a Glassdoor review names it as ADEPT-15 style). Reported as ~20 minutes and non-eliminatory by FACE Prep.
prep: Answer consistently; similar statements repeat in different forms.
Read each pair carefully and pick the one closest to how you actually work.
Do not rush: it is reported to be untimed or loosely timed.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.what_they_check: Projects, OOP, DBMS, OS, DSA basics and one language (per candidate reviews). Senior Analyst candidates face a more advanced technical interview.
prep: Explain your project's architecture and your role in detail.
Revise OOP pillars, SQL queries and normalization.
Practise one or two simple coding questions you can write and explain live.

rounds.name: HR Interview
rounds.what_they_check: Communication, flexibility and fit; followed by document verification before the offer (per FACE Prep).
prep: Prepare answers on relocation and shifts.
Prepare 'Why Capgemini?' using its official careers content.
Keep all academic documents ready for verification.

cutoffs.note: Not published by Capgemini. Secondary sources agree on per-section qualifying thresholds (clearing the overall score alone is not enough) and that Senior Analyst needs a higher cutoff, but the reported percentages conflict and are candidate-reported, so no number is given here.

cse_it.note: The online test emphasises pseudocode rather than a separate coding round; CSE/IT candidates should target Senior Analyst and expect deeper DSA/OS questions.

ece_eee.note: Generally eligible for fresher drives (confirm branch list in your notice). Strong pseudocode tracing and one language suffice for Analyst.

mech_civil.note: Generally eligible (confirm in notice). Focus on pseudocode, English and game-based aptitude; be ready to explain your interest in IT.

all.note: A secondary guide (Unstop) cites above 60% in the qualifying degree and no backlogs. Capgemini's official page says rounds vary by role and may include a coding/technical assessment or group discussion.

jd_skills.note: Pseudocode section of the online test.
One language for pseudocode tracing and the technical interview.
Deeper DSA questions reported for Senior Analyst.
Helpful talking point; not a stated requirement.

hr_focus: Willingness to relocate and work flexible shifts.
Why Capgemini and your career goals.
Document and eligibility verification before the offer.
